findings.title: Pin that classifyNotFound runs on the whitespace-collapsed, lowercased text so the L2 'Not found:' marker still matches after rawToText collapses its newline
findings.fix: State that classifyNotFound receives the rawToText-collapsed, lowercased text (identical to inferProseStatus input) so 'File:\nNot found:' -> 'file: ... not found:' still matches /\bnot found:/; add a test feeding a verbatim post-collapse L2 notice and asserting blocked + path-confirmation blocker.

findings.title: AC-4 wording contradicts the intentional Known_Target denylist bypass for suggestions
findings.location: AC-4 vs Layer 2 §B 'knownTarget per-candidate bypass is INTENTIONAL'
findings.fix: Amend AC-4 to exempt a Known_Target the user named (matching the tool's own read-gate), so the acceptance criterion and design body agree; keep both the non-known-target-dropped and known-target-allowed tests.

findings.title: buildPathConfirmationBlocker path-extraction regex ordering, extension allow-list completeness, and multi-token behavior under-specified
findings.fix: Pin a single ordered extraction rule (slash-and-extension token first, then known-extension token, then generic fallback), broaden or explicitly scope the extension set as a degrade-to-generic heuristic, and add tests for a no-slash path and a two-path-token message.
